name: 沙贾汗

points.title: 童年岁月
points.description: 沙贾汗出生于莫卧儿帝国贵族家庭，是贾汉吉尔皇帝的第三个儿子。在拉合尔度过的童年时期，他接受了全面的教育，包括波斯语、阿拉伯语、突厥语的学习，以及军事、骑术和狩猎等技能的训练。这段时期为他日后成为一位有文化的统治者奠定了基础，同时也培养了他对建筑艺术的浓厚兴趣，尤其是对莫卧儿建筑风格的欣赏。
points.descriptionEn: Born into Mughal royalty, Shah Jahan was the third son of Emperor Jahangir. His childhood in Lahore was marked by comprehensive education in Persian, Arabic, and Turkish languages, as well as training in military arts, horsemanship, and hunting. This period laid the foundation for his cultured reign and nurtured his deep appreciation for Mughal architectural styles, which would later define his legacy.

points.title: 王子历练
points.description: 在阿格拉期间，沙贾汗作为王子接受了系统的政治和军事训练。他先后被任命为德干、古吉拉特和拉贾斯坦等地区的总督，积累了丰富的行政经验。1617年，他在德干地区平定了叛乱，展现了军事才能。1623-1625年间，他与父亲贾汉吉尔发生权力冲突，短暂叛乱后被赦免。这段经历使沙贾汗认识到权力斗争的残酷性，也锻炼了他的政治手腕。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in Agra, Prince Khurram (Shah Jahan's birth name) received systematic political and military training. He served as governor of various regions including Deccan, Gujarat, and Rajasthan, gaining valuable administrative experience. In 1617, he demonstrated military prowess by suppressing rebellions in the Deccan. A power struggle with his father Jahangir from 1623-1625, though brief, taught him the harsh realities of court politics and honed his political acumen.

points.title: 登基初期
points.description: 1628年，沙贾汗在父亲贾汉吉尔去世后继承皇位，成为莫卧儿帝国第五位皇帝。他迅速巩固权力，处决了潜在竞争对手，包括自己的兄弟和侄子。在位初期，他继续推行父亲的政策，重视贸易和经济发展，与欧洲列强建立外交关系。1631年，他的爱妻穆塔兹·玛哈尔在生育第十四个孩子时去世，这一事件成为沙贾汗人生的转折点，也促使他决心建造泰姬陵作为对妻子的永恒纪念。
points.descriptionEn: Ascending the throne in 1628 after Jahangir's death, Shah Jahan quickly consolidated power by eliminating potential rivals, including his brothers and nephews. During his early reign, he continued his father's policies emphasizing trade and economic development, establishing diplomatic relations with European powers. The death of his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal in 1631 while giving birth to their fourteenth child became a turning point in his life, inspiring his decision to build the Taj Mahal as an eternal monument to her memory.

points.title: 建筑辉煌
points.description: 这一时期是沙贾汗建筑成就的巅峰。1632年，他开始建造泰姬陵，历时22年，动用了两万名工匠，耗费了帝国大量财富。除了泰姬陵，他还扩建了阿格拉堡，修建了贾汗吉尔宫和珍珠清真寺等建筑。这些建筑融合了波斯、伊斯兰和印度建筑风格，达到了莫卧儿艺术的巅峰。然而，大规模的建筑工程也消耗了帝国大量资源，为后来的财政困难埋下伏笔。沙贾汗对建筑的热爱体现了他对美的追求和对永恒的渴望。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the zenith of Shah Jahan's architectural achievements. In 1632, he began construction of the Taj Mahal, a project that took 22 years, employed 20,000 artisans, and consumed vast imperial resources. Beyond the Taj Mahal, he expanded the Agra Fort, built the Jahangiri Mahal and Pearl Mosque. These structures blended Persian, Islamic, and Indian architectural styles, reaching the pinnacle of Mughal art. However, these massive construction projects drained imperial resources, sowing seeds for future financial difficulties.

points.title: 囚禁岁月
points.description: 1657年，沙贾汗因重病引发继承权争夺战，次子奥朗则布击败其他兄弟后于1658年篡位。沙贾汗被软禁在阿格拉堡的穆萨宫，在这里度过了人生的最后八年。尽管被囚禁，他仍能透过窗户眺望泰姬陵，每天都能看到自己为爱妻建造的陵墓。1666年，沙贾汗在阿格拉堡去世，与穆塔兹·玛哈尔合葬于泰姬陵。他的囚禁生涯成为权力斗争残酷性的见证，也象征着莫卧儿帝国由盛转衰的转折点。
points.descriptionEn: In 1657, Shah Jahan's illness triggered a war of succession. His son Aurangzeb defeated his brothers and seized power in 1658. Shah Jahan was confined to the Musamman Burj in Agra Fort, where he spent his final eight years. Despite his imprisonment, he could gaze through the window at the Taj Mahal, the monument he built for his beloved wife. Shah Jahan died in Agra Fort in 1666 and was buried beside Mumtaz Mahal in the Taj Mahal. His imprisonment became a testament to the brutality of power struggles and symbolized the turning point from the zenith to the decline of the Mughal Empire.

supporter.zh: 沙贾汗被视为莫卧儿帝国最伟大的统治者之一，他的统治时期被称为莫卧儿帝国的'黄金时代'。他不仅是一位杰出的军事统帅和行政管理者，更是一位热爱艺术的赞助人。在他的支持下，莫卧儿艺术和建筑达到了前所未有的高度，泰姬陵成为世界七大奇迹之一，代表了人类对美的极致追求。他促进了帝国的经济发展和国际贸易，使莫卧儿帝国成为当时世界上最富有的国家之一。
supporter.en: Shah Jahan is regarded as one of the greatest Mughal emperors, with his reign often called the 'Golden Age' of the Mughal Empire. He was not only an accomplished military commander and administrator but also a passionate patron of the arts. Under his patronage, Mughal art and architecture reached unprecedented heights, with the Taj Mahal becoming one of the Seven Wonders of the World, representing humanity's ultimate pursuit of beauty. He promoted economic development and international trade, making the Mughal Empire one of the wealthiest nations in the world.

critic.zh: 批评者认为沙贾汗的统治存在严重问题。他处决亲属巩固权力的做法反映了莫卧儿宫廷的残酷性。他耗费巨资建造奢华建筑，导致帝国财政困难，为后来的衰落埋下隐患。在宗教政策上，他虽然相对宽容，但对印度教寺庙的破坏行为也受到批评。此外，他的晚年因继承权争夺而引发的内战削弱了帝国实力，显示出他在继承人培养方面的失败。这些批评者认为，沙贾汗的个人审美追求牺牲了帝国的长远利益。
critic.en: Critics point to significant flaws in Shah Jahan's reign. His execution of relatives to consolidate power reflects the brutality of the Mughal court. His extravagant construction projects drained imperial finances, sowing seeds for future decline. While relatively tolerant in religious matters, his destruction of Hindu temples has also been criticized. Furthermore, the succession war that marked his later years weakened the empire, revealing his failure in proper heir training. These critics argue that Shah Jahan's personal aesthetic pursuits came at the expense of the empire's long-term interests.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，沙贾汗是一位复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是莫卧儿帝国鼎盛时期的伟大统治者，也是帝国由盛转衰的关键人物。历史学界普遍认为，他的建筑成就确实达到了莫卧儿艺术的巅峰，但同时也承认他的政策消耗了帝国资源。在流行文化中，沙贾汗主要被塑造成一位深情丈夫的形象，泰姬陵成为爱情的永恒象征。然而，这种浪漫化叙事往往忽视了他作为统治者的复杂性和政治遗产。沙贾汗的一生反映了权力、爱情与艺术之间的永恒张力。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Shah Jahan emerges as a complex and contradictory figure. He was both a great ruler during the Mughal Empire's zenith and a key figure in its transition from prosperity to decline. Historians generally acknowledge that his architectural achievements reached the pinnacle of Mughal art while recognizing that his policies drained imperial resources. In popular culture, Shah Jahan is primarily romanticized as a devoted husband, with the Taj Mahal symbolizing eternal love. However, this romanticized narrative often overlooks the complexity of his rule and political legacy. Shah Jahan's life reflects the eternal tension between power, love, and art.

self.zh: 让太阳和月亮都黯然失色的建筑，将永远存在。
self.en: Let the sun and moon shed tears from their eyes. Time shall not dim its splendor.

others.zh: 沙贾汗是一位伟大的建筑师，却是一位糟糕的统治者。他建造了世界上最美丽的陵墓，却无法为自己的帝国建造稳固的未来。
others.en: Shah Jahan was a great architect but a poor ruler. He built the world's most beautiful tomb, yet could not build a secure future for his empire.

othersBy: 英国历史学家威廉·达尔林普尔
